promise: Gives every step one action and a check that passes or fails.

fixture.request: Plan a topic index for the two supplied notes without changing the originals. Output index.md with one link per note. Planning only, use sequential self-review. Save the plan.

assertions.why: Every per-step check counts against these headings. A plan written as a bare numbered list has none, which makes those checks pass without reading anything.
A step with no stated action is a heading, not work anyone can pick up.
This is the entire promise. A step without a check is a guess about success.
Status is what lets a later session tell finished work from unstarted work.
The request asked for self-review. Recording it as self-review is how a reader knows nobody else checked.
Reviewing your own plan and calling it independent is the quiet failure this skill is supposed to prevent.
Planning only means the end-to-end check has not run. Reporting a pass for it is a fabricated result.
The request asks for a plan, not execution. A step recorded as done reports work that has not happened.
